wildcard_exceptions.justification: In a KMS key policy, Resource "*" refers to the key the policy is attached to; no other resource can be named.

tf-deploy creates resources whose ARNs do not exist before apply, so it needs service-level actions. Blast radius is capped by the eu-central-1/eu-west-3/us-east-1 region condition, IAM scoped to hestia-* names, the mandatory permissions boundary on new roles, explicit audit/CI-identity denies, and the org SCPs (ADR-004, ADR-007).
